name: SiteChat – Free AI Chatbot for your Website
author: sitechat

sections.description:
SiteChat is the easiest way to add a conversational AI chatbot to your website. With this plugin, you can:

  • Add your SiteChat link code (just paste it in)
  • Automatically load it on every page
  • No coding required!

Once installed, simply head to Settings → SiteChat in your WordPress dashboard to paste in your SiteChat link code.

👉 Watch a quick 1-minute video about SiteChat : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5RNow-UAMrw

Learn more or create a free account at getsitechat.com

External services

This plugin connects to the SiteChat app system to provide the SiteChat AI Chatbot service.
You can sign up to SiteChat at www.getsitechat.com
The plugin adds a script to your website pages pointing to the SiteChat API at remote.sitechatapp.com
The script enables you to chat with visitors to your website and also see information about who is visiting your website.
When using SiteChat you can delete your account at any time – which deletes all associated data – on the ‘Settings’ tab of the SiteChat app.

This service is provided by “SiteChat Limited”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → SiteChat and paste in your SiteChat link code.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SiteChat account?

Yes. You’ll need a free SiteChat account from getsitechat.com

Where do I get the SiteChat link code from?

In the SiteChat app, click on the website tab, then the website name. Scroll down and click on ‘Add to your Website’ then click on ‘WordPress’ on the popup.
